#  Set-up    !!VERY IMPORTANT!!

Create a NEW superflat world, then select "Customize", click "presets" and select "The Void".

Upload the datapack to the world.

As an operator, run:

```
/function ghast_gauntlet_dogfights:setup_world
```

That will create a small platform and teleport all players to it. It will also shrink the world border size.

## The game is ready to be run!

Simply click the button at the middle of the lobby to start a game!

---

Have fun!
